hints.title: Greedy Mass Absorption
hints.text: Destroying smaller asteroids first increases your mass before confronting larger obstacles.

hints.title: Ascending Sort Strategy
hints.text: Sort asteroids in non-decreasing order to maximize survival probability at each collision.

hints.title: Collision Verification
hints.text: If current mass is at least the asteroid mass, absorb it; otherwise collision destruction is impossible.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting asteroids in ascending order
complexity.notes: Greedily destroying the smallest available asteroid maximizes mass growth.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Challenging larger asteroids first risks early termination when smaller masses could be absorbed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting ascending ensures mass is monotonically maximized at every collision step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should sort asteroids and greedily absorb them in non-decreasing order.
